title: Agile Project Estimator (Streamlit App)
summary: A Streamlit application and set of Jupyter notebooks for estimating agile software project effort (man-months) using machine learning models trained on ISBSG project data. Notebooks in the repo generate synthetic tabular training data by fitting SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on the cleaned ISBSG dataset and evaluating it with evaluate_quality.
evidence: synthetic_data_generation-checkpoint.ipynb: 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)' then fit/sample; also imports evaluate_quality
needs: Separate notebook also imports standalone ctgan package as a fallback; not counted here as sdv.
